title: Trust Continuity Compatibility Crosswalk v0.1
title_zh: 信任连续性兼容交叉映射 v0.1
purpose: Map upstream version, registry and telemetry facts to the existing DBA conclusion-continuity gate without creating a runtime, schema, protocol, identity system, registry or observability backend.

verified_facts: An agent is a reusable versioned configuration containing model, system prompt, tools, MCP servers and skills.
A session can override model, system prompt, tools, MCP servers and skills without changing the agent.
An existing session can replace its tools and MCP servers after session creation.

profile_mapping.conclusion_inheritance_rule: Agent ID and agent version equality are insufficient when the effective session capability state differs or cannot be compared.

unknowns: No Anthropic session was created or executed in this reconciliation.
The documentation does not prove any TITMAS, DBOS or SAEE integration.

verified_facts: Registry records support DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, REJECTED and terminal DEPRECATED lifecycle states.
Editing or synchronizing an APPROVED record creates a new DRAFT revision while the approved revision remains searchable.
Search and MCP return the approved revision, while Get and List return the latest revision.
MCP endpoints and A2A Agent Cards can be synchronized into records and an update creates a new revision.
The documentation still labels the namespace move from bedrock-agentcore to agent-registry as upcoming even though it names August 6, 2026 as the start date.

compatibility_axes.latest_registry_revision: Latest revision returned by Get or List, including a DRAFT revision.
compatibility_axes.approved_effective_revision: Approved revision returned by Search or the registry MCP endpoint.
compatibility_axes.bound_or_executed_revision: Exact revision and descriptor digest actually selected by the consuming or executing context.

profile_mapping.conclusion_inheritance_rule: Latest, approved and executed revisions must be recorded separately; registry record identity alone is insufficient.

unknowns: The documentation did not establish that the namespace migration was complete in every region on 2026-08-15.
No AWS registry, record or regional endpoint was invoked in this reconciliation.

verified_facts: Issue 386 proposes self_reported and externally_observed as evidence-origin values.
The proposal explicitly separates observation origin from signing or accountability.
Unset must remain unknown rather than defaulting to self_reported.
The issue remained open with no milestone and no associated pull request when verified.

compatibility_axes.signer_or_accountability: Who signed or is accountable for the record.

profile_mapping.conclusion_inheritance_rule: Observation origin, signer/accountability and claim content are independent axes and must not be inferred from one another.

unknowns: The proposed attribute name and values can change before any specification or release.
No published semantic-conventions version was identified as adopting the proposal.

upstream_tracking.relevance: Owner, sponsor and manager relationships plus sponsor reassignment are authority-context inputs; a relationship change maps to EC-05-CREDENTIAL and REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Track identity, trust lifecycle and continuous-assessment terminology; do not claim a final standard, contribution, membership or adoption.

required_corrections_applied: Each case maps to existing EC triggers and explicit fail-closed results.
Latest, approved and executed registry revisions are separated.
No new runtime, schema or protocol is introduced.
